subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call — next steps & scheduling

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moore <alex.moore@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call — follow up & next steps

Hi Alex — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap from our discovery: FinTechCo is evaluating a dedicated deployment to support your customer-facing chat assistant ("SmartServe") with strict latency SLAs and predictable monthly throughput. Key points I captured: 

- Peak concurrent users: ~3k during business hours (estimated)
- Average request size: 350 tokens in + 200 tokens generated on average
- Target p95 latency: <= 150ms for single-turn text generation
- Expected steady-state tokens/month: ~2.4B

Next step: we recommend a 30–45m dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) to align on throughput/latency requirements, model choice, and autoscaling policy. Would you be able to share the best attendee list from your side (networking/infrastructure, ML infra, and an engineering lead) so we can invite the right Redwood folks?

Proposed slots: 
- Tue May 3, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed May 4, 14:00–14:45 PT

I attached a short pre-call questionnaire that helps us tailor the sizing (request/response token distributions, batching tolerance, burst patterns, VPC constraints). If you can fill and return before the call it speeds things up.

Thanks — happy to adjust times.

Best,
David Kim
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_pre-call_capacity_questionnaire.docx
